task: ¿Te gustaría ser nómada digital? Escribe un párrafo (80–100 palabras) con ventajas, desventajas y tu opinión.
paragraphs: Five years ago, Marta Gil was working in a bank in Madrid. She spent two hours a day commuting and rarely saw the sun in winter. Today she works as a web designer from wherever she likes: last month it was a café in Lisbon, this month it is a shared office in Mexico City.

Marta is one of a growing number of "digital nomads", people who use technology to work remotely while they travel. Since 2020, when many companies sent their employees home, more and more people have realised that their job does not depend on a particular desk. Several countries, including Portugal, Spain and Costa Rica, now offer special visas for remote workers.

The lifestyle sounds like a dream, but it has its difficulties. "People think I'm on holiday all the time," Marta says. "But I work eight hours a day like anyone else, and sometimes more, because my clients are in different time zones." Finding a reliable internet connection can be stressful, and moving every few weeks means she often feels lonely. "You make friends quickly, but then you have to say goodbye."

There are also practical problems. Digital nomads need to think carefully about taxes, health insurance and, sometimes, the effect they have on local communities. In some popular cities, rents have gone up as more foreigners arrive, which has made life harder for local residents.
Would Marta go back to an office? "Never say never," she laughs. "But for now, I'm learning more than I ever learned at a desk."
